Weld Tech Group

reliability proven by time!

Your reliable partner in the installation of technological pipelines and production of industrial metal structures.

Know More Contact Us

15+ years of experience in industrial facilities.

We specialize in professional welding and installation of technological pipelines, production of equipment and metal structures for chemical, food, pharmaceutical and other industrial sectors.

Our Mission — providing reliable, innovative and environmentally friendly solutions in welding and metal processing, contributing to the development of industry in local and international markets. We strive not only to meet customer needs, but also to exceed their expectations through high quality work, use of advanced technologies and continuous process improvement.

Our team of experienced specialists carries out projects in Poland, Lithuania, Germany and other EU countries.

Our Services
We guarantee high-quality work completed within the established deadlines.
We apply innovative welding technologies for optimal combination of quality, speed and costs.
We use certified and exclusively high-quality equipment and materials.

Over

50

highly qualified workers with years of experience in welding composite materials and other materials with complex weldability properties.

Our team — are highly qualified welders and constructors who regularly undergo training and master modern technologies, document and certify each stage of work. A key role in the company is played by welders who can perform "mirror welding", as well as welding pipes from stainless steel, various alloys and structures. They flawlessly handle work on materials from carbon and alloy steel (including carbides) to difficult-to-weld metals, ensuring high quality of connections and assembly.

Welder

Our Services

Using years of experience, we have learned to find solutions for every task without neglecting quality and implementation deadlines.

Installation of technological pipelines

We professionally deal with the installation and welding of technological pipelines made of stainless steel (AISI-304L, AISI-308L, AISI-316L, AISI-321), carbon steels (St.20, 30), as well as titanium and aluminum.

Know More

Equipment for industry

We manufacture additional equipment for various production lines and systems used in chemical, food, pharmaceutical and related industries.

Know More

Production of capacitive equipment

We professionally deal with the installation and welding of technological pipelines made of stainless steel (AISI-304L, AISI-308L, AISI-316L, AISI-321), carbon steels (St.20, 30), as well as titanium and aluminum.

Know More

Metal structures and service platforms

We manufacture and install metal structures of various complexity, including trusses, stairs, railings, frames for mounting control cabinets and much more. All products meet strength and safety standards.

Project Gallery

Work Stages

Our approach to work is based on thorough preparation, strict compliance with technical regulations, and close collaboration with clients at every stage.

Consultation

At the first consultation, we clarify the main requirements and specifics of the project, answer the client's questions, and discuss the further work plan.

1

Analysis and Planning

We determine technical parameters, deadlines, and budget, taking into account industry nuances and local regulations.

2

Design

We create detailed drawings and 3D models, coordinate specifications, and material delivery schedules.

3

Production and Welding Works

We use modern technologies (WIG–TIG, MIG–MAG, orbital welding, and others) and certified materials.

4

Installation and Verification

Experienced teams go to the site, perform installation and commissioning. We conduct tests for tightness, strength, and compliance with technical requirements.

5

Handover and Service

We prepare necessary documentation (certificates, acceptance reports), provide warranties, and if needed, ensure service maintenance.
